rows.DSC_STMT: DECLARE propertycode r5properties.pro_code%TYPE; BEGIN UPDATE r5mp2npsdt_ext a SET a.pro_code = (SELECT DISTINCT d.pro_code FROM r5mp2npsdt b, r5mp2npsdt c, r5mp2npsdt_ext d WHERE b.zcp_uprecnum = a.zcp_uprecnum AND b.zcp_upcode = c.zcp_upcode AND b.zcp_fieldname = c.zcp_fieldname AND b.zcp_fieldtype = c.zcp_fieldtype AND c.zcp_uprecnum = d.zcp_uprecnum AND d.pro_code IS NOT NULL AND rownum = 1) WHERE a.zcp_uprecnum = :uprecnum RETURNING a.pro_code INTO propertycode; IF (propertycode IS NOT NULL) THEN o7cvmain.logrecordstatus(:logid, :uprecnum, 'S', null); ELSE o7cv.setnextseq('R5PROPERTIES','PRO_CODE'); END IF; END;
rows.DSC_STMT_SS:
BEGIN   declare @sPropertycode nvarchar(8)
  declare c1 cursor local for 
    SELECT DISTINCT d.pro_code
        FROM r5mp2npsdt b, r5mp2npsdt c, r5mp2npsdt_ext d
       WHERE b.zcp_uprecnum = :uprecnum
         AND b.zcp_upcode = c.zcp_upcode
         AND b.zcp_fieldname = c.zcp_fieldname
         AND b.zcp_fieldtype = c.zcp_fieldtype
         AND c.zcp_uprecnum = d.zcp_uprecnum
         AND d.pro_code IS NOT NULL

  open c1
  fetch next from c1 into @sPropertycode
  close c1
  deallocate c1

  UPDATE r5mp2npsdt_ext
     SET pro_code = @sPropertycode
   WHERE zcp_uprecnum = :uprecnum

  IF (@sPropertycode IS NOT NULL)
    execute dbo.o7cvmain_logrecordstatus :logid, :uprecnum, N'S', null
  ELSE
    execute dbo.o7cv_setnextseq_2 N'R5PROPERTIES', N'PRO_CODE'
END

rows.DSC_STMT: DECLARE propertycode r5properties.pro_code%TYPE; BEGIN UPDATE r5mp2npsdt_ext a SET a.pro_code = (SELECT DISTINCT d.pro_code FROM r5mp2npsdt b, r5mp2npsdt c, r5mp2npsdt_ext d WHERE b.zcp_uprecnum = a.zcp_uprecnum AND b.zcp_upcode = c.zcp_upcode AND b.zcp_fieldname = c.zcp_fieldname AND b.zcp_fieldtype = c.zcp_fieldtype AND c.zcp_uprecnum = d.zcp_uprecnum AND d.pro_code IS NOT NULL AND rownum = 1) WHERE a.zcp_uprecnum = :uprecnum RETURNING a.pro_code INTO propertycode; IF (propertycode IS NOT NULL) THEN o7cvmain.logrecordstatus(:logid, :uprecnum, 'S', null); ELSE o7cv.setnextseq('R5PROPERTIES','PRO_CODE'); END IF; END;
rows.DSC_STMT_SS:
BEGIN   declare @sPropertycode nvarchar(8)
  declare c1 cursor local for 
    SELECT DISTINCT d.pro_code
        FROM r5mp2npsdt b, r5mp2npsdt c, r5mp2npsdt_ext d
       WHERE b.zcp_uprecnum = :uprecnum
         AND b.zcp_upcode = c.zcp_upcode
         AND b.zcp_fieldname = c.zcp_fieldname
         AND b.zcp_fieldtype = c.zcp_fieldtype
         AND c.zcp_uprecnum = d.zcp_uprecnum
         AND d.pro_code IS NOT NULL

  open c1
  fetch next from c1 into @sPropertycode
  close c1
  deallocate c1

  UPDATE r5mp2npsdt_ext
     SET pro_code = @sPropertycode
   WHERE zcp_uprecnum = :uprecnum

  IF (@sPropertycode IS NOT NULL)
    execute dbo.o7cvmain_logrecordstatus :logid, :uprecnum, N'S', null
  ELSE
    execute dbo.o7cv_setnextseq_2 N'R5PROPERTIES', N'PRO_CODE'
END
